The model key was read from /var/run/model-gateway-key/key into the scripts alone and never printed.

Observation, not a failure, for the architect: a session may register the wildcard interest notifications.team.> (or notifications.team.*) and the listener puts that wildcard straight into its JetStream consumer filter (measured: s-ses_probe2 filters notifications.agent.ses_probe2 and notifications.team.>), so one session durably receives every team topic, stored copies included. ReachesPrivateStreamSubject refuses a wildcard that reaches a private subject, and the team namespace is not private, so nothing refuses this one. Overlapping filters are collapsed rather than refused (a registration naming both notifications.team.> and notifications.team.deploy answers 200 and the consumer keeps the wildcard alone), so it strands no session. Before this change the same session read team topics from a core subscription; what is new is that the reach is now durable and replayed.
